title: Encoding an arithmetic machine state
statement: Let $p$ be a natural number and let a state consist of a matrix $R$ and natural numbers $d,m,r$. Encode $p$ in binary as the first component of a pair; its second component is a nested pair encoding, in order, the matrix $R$, $d$, a string of $m$ true bits, and a string of $r$ true bits. Each pairing doubles every bit of the first string, appends the separator $01$, then appends the second string.
hypotheses_covered: A state consisting of a matrix and three natural numbers
